test_slab_from_bulk_all_slabs: test Slab.from_bulk_get_all_slabs to retrieve all slabs from a Bulk object by database ID
test_slab_from_specific_millers: test Slab.from_bulk_get_specific_millers to generate slabs for a given Miller index tuple from a Bulk
test_slab_random_sampling: test Slab.from_bulk_get_random_slab to randomly sample a slab from a Bulk with seeded randomness
test_bulk_init_by_id: test Bulk initialization using bulk_id_from_db to load a bulk structure from the database
test_bulk_init_by_src_id: test Bulk initialization using bulk_src_id_from_db to load a bulk structure by source ID like mp-30
